nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Health assurance pathway for Central Armed Police Forces personnel and their dependants using the PM-JAY technology and empanelled healthcare network.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligible serving/retired CAPF personnel and eligible dependants under the notified CAPF scheme rules and force-wise coverage.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Ayushman CAPF.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
